_note: Per-exercise overrides for the looping previews. The default is to start a third of the way into the clip and take 4s, which usually lands on the reps — but some clips put the good part somewhere else. Set 'start' (seconds) and optionally 'length' to fix one. scripts/make_previews.py re-cuts any exercise listed here on every run, so editing a number is enough.
